en: The sandstorm is far too fierce. There's no going on without something to shield the eyes!
The sandstorm is far too fierce. There's no going on without something to shield the eyes!
Victor
Well, hello there! We're the Winstrates, a family of Pokémon trainers, every one of us.
How about it? Will you take on the whole family, one after another?
Battle the Winstrate family?
That's the spirit! I'll start us off.
Ha! You're strong. But the family's only getting started!
Victoria
So you beat my husband? Then you'll have to deal with me next!
Oh my, you really are good. Our daughter's itching to try you, though.
Vivi
Mum and Dad both lost? No way! I'll win for the family!
Aww... Grandma! It's your turn!
Vicky
My, my. You've beaten my whole family? Then this old lady will show you how it's done!
Goodness! Four in a row! Do come inside, dear. The family would love to meet you properly.
No? Well, our door's always open. Come back when you're ready!
Victor
You beat us all! Come in and visit any time.
Girl
I water these berry trees every day, and look how well they're doing! Here, take one.
One day I'm going to grow berries in colours nobody has ever seen!
I wonder what colour of berry I should try for today...
Man
These rocks are cracked all over. A good Rock Smash and they'd crumble to bits.
Sometimes a Pokémon that was hiding underneath comes tumbling out! It gave me such a fright.
